items.a: Lordevs is a web development agency offering five services: custom business website design and development, CMS development on WordPress, Webflow or a headless CMS, PPC landing pages for Google and Meta Ads, SEO and AEO optimisation, and website redesign and repair. One team handles strategy, design, build, launch and ongoing optimisation.

items.q: How much does a business website cost?
items.a: The cost of a business website depends on the number of pages, how custom the design is, the CMS, integrations such as booking or e-commerce, and who writes the content. A single landing page costs far less than a multi-page site with a blog. After a free 30-minute consultation we send a fixed, itemised quote with no hidden fees.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: A typical business website takes 3–6 weeks from kickoff to launch. A single PPC landing page can go live in 1–2 weeks, while larger CMS or e-commerce builds take longer. You get a clear, week-by-week timeline after our free consultation, and we share progress at every stage.

items.q: What is a CMS and do I need one?
items.a: A CMS (Content Management System) such as WordPress or Webflow lets you edit pages, blogs and images yourself without touching code. If you plan to update your website regularly, you need one. We recommend the best CMS for your goals, build it, and train your team to use it.

items.q: Should I choose WordPress or Webflow for my business website?
items.a: Choose WordPress if you need a large plugin ecosystem, WooCommerce e-commerce or full hosting control. Choose Webflow if you want design freedom, built-in hosting and an editor non-technical teams find simple. For high-traffic or multi-channel content, a headless CMS like Sanity or Strapi with Next.js is often the best fit.

items.q: How are PPC landing pages different from a normal website?
items.a: A PPC landing page has one goal: turning paid clicks from Google Ads or Meta Ads into leads or sales. Unlike a full website, it removes navigation and distractions, matches the exact message of your ad and loads in under two seconds, which improves Quality Score and lowers your cost per lead.

items.q: What is AEO and how is it different from SEO?
items.a: SEO (Search Engine Optimisation) helps your website rank in Google search results. AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) structures your content, FAQs and schema markup so AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews can understand, quote and recommend your business. They work together, and Lordevs does both.

items.q: How long does SEO take to show results?
items.a: Most websites see early SEO improvements within 3 months and meaningful traffic growth within 6 months, depending on competition, site history and content. Lordevs clients average 3X organic traffic growth within six months of launch. We send monthly reports so you can see exactly which pages and keywords are improving.

items.q: Will a website redesign hurt my Google rankings?
items.a: Not when it is done properly. Before a redesign we map every existing URL, keep or improve your best-ranking content, set up 301 redirects and monitor Google Search Console after launch. Most ranking drops after a redesign come from missing redirects or deleted content, and our migration process prevents both.

items.q: Do I own my website after it is built?
items.a: Yes. You own your domain, design, content and CMS accounts outright. We hand over every login at launch, train your team to edit the site, and never lock you into proprietary systems or contracts you cannot leave.

items.q: Do you work with clients in other countries?
items.a: Yes. Lordevs works with businesses in more than 35 countries. Every project runs remotely, with calls on Google Meet booked in your local time zone, a shared project timeline and a single point of contact from kickoff to launch.

items.q: Do you provide support after launch?
items.a: Yes. After launch we offer website maintenance, hosting guidance, security and plugin updates, backups and monthly SEO and performance reporting, so your website stays fast, secure and keeps climbing in search results.
